## 维护者速读
- 改了什么：给 `@objectstack/platform-objects` 加上俄语（ru）：平台对象、Studio 的元数据表单、Setup/Studio/Account 导航、系统概览仪表板和用户/组织记录页的内嵌文字，做法与已合并的 fr（#31233）、pt-BR（#31440）逐文件一致。同一 PR 顺手修好 fr 的 `pages.connect_agent.subtitle`：按当前英文重译并刷新摘要。
- 为什么改：ru 是 #30512 要补的第五个语言（之后是 de、ko）。fr 那条副标题是按旧英文翻的，摘要过期，fr 用户目前看到的是英文回退。
- 风险与回滚：新增 ru 文件、注册行和测试里的语言列表；已有语言只改 fr 的一条副标题和它的摘要，其余 23 个生成文件字节不变；新文字同样走 source-hash 回退。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/ru.ts`（导航钉住项），`fr.ts` + `fr.source-hashes.ts` 里 `connect_agent.subtitle` 的两行改动，`ru.source-hashes.generated.ts`（45 条与英文相同的叶子，下面逐类列出）。
- 两分钟验证：`cd packages/platform-objects && npx vitest run src/apps/translations/source-hash.test.ts src/apps/translations/app-nav-translation-parity.test.ts`，预期 2 个文件、111 个测试通过。
- 需要你做的：生成文件让本 PR 超过了 3000 行，所以要请 os-zhuang 或 hotlong 批准（或维护者直接合并）。席位 ACCEPT 是 PR 评论 6720497415，Head-sha `efe02a1756a3e095bfa458add5860f81776726ad`。批准后由席位落地。

## What changes
- New `ru` bundles in `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations`: `ru.objects.generated.ts` (1697 leaves), `ru.metadata-forms.generated.ts` (1263 leaves), their provenance table `ru.source-hashes.generated.ts` (45 deliberate byte copies of `en`, listed under Acceptance notes), the hand-authored `ru.ts` (141 leaves) and `ru.source-hashes.ts` recording the `en` digest of every hand leaf.
- Registration: the extract config's `--locales` docstring and `translations:` baseline, `setup.translation.ts`, the `apps` barrel, and `metadata-translations/index.ts`.
- Inline maps: 36 in `sys-user.page.ts`, 6 in `sys-organization.page.ts`, and the System Overview null label in `system.datasets.ts` (`Система`).
- Wording pins, as #31233 lists them: `nav_account_approvals` reads as plugin-approvals' `my_pending` label (`Ждут моего решения`), `nav_assignment_rules` as `sys_assignment_rule`'s plural label (`Правила назначения`), each `nav_settings_*` (including `nav_settings_access_policy`, `Политика доступа`) as its service-settings hub title, `nav_settings_hub` as the console's `backToHub` (`Все настройки`), and the four #30935 keys: `grp_account_ai_assistant` = `ИИ-ассистент`; both `nav_connect_agent` entries and `pages.connect_agent.label` = `Подключить ИИ-ассистента`.
- **fr fix:** `pages.connect_agent.subtitle` in `fr.ts` was translated from the previous English subtitle (it spoke of "any MCP-compatible AI client"), and `fr.source-hashes.ts` recorded that old digest (`b0d7c6d174511bcb`), so the source-hash fallback served `fr` readers the English sentence. It is now retranslated from the current English text (`Travaillez dans ce système depuis Claude, Doubao et d’autres assistants IA. Chacun agit en votre nom : il ne voit et ne modifie que ce que vos propres autorisations permettent.`) and its digest is `51c467af44024a1b`, which equals the digest the table derives from `en` today. No other `fr` leaf changes.
- Changeset `.changeset/30512-platform-objects-ru.md` (patch), which also names the `fr` fix.

## Tests
- `ru` added beside `pt-BR` to the locale lists of every test #31440 widened (vocabulary, nav parity, dead-key tombstone, source-hash, bu-rename with `old: /Отдел/`, the five identity copy tests, record-page tabs, null label, per-user stores, plugin translation loads), plus plugin-approvals `approval-status-vocabulary`, plugin-security `people-org-assignment-nav-contribution` and service-settings `setup-nav-hub-parity`. The cli `platform-page-i18n-parity` LOCALE_KEY shape already accepts `ru`.
- No new negative pin: #31440's plugin-audit `pt-BR` twin test is outside this claim's file surface, so no `ru` twin is added here (see Acceptance notes).

## Acceptance notes
- Every leaf is translated. The 45 byte copies of `en` the extract records are identifiers and header names (`ID` ×24, `API` ×2, `JWKS`, `JWKS URI`, `Message-ID`, `Slug`, `Web`, `snake_case`, the SAML `urn:…:emailAddress` NameID format, the `openid email profile` / `email` / `name` defaults), lowercase option values that are identifiers (`cron`, `dlq`, `api`, `web`), and the five JSON examples kept verbatim as every locale keeps them.
- No catalog test refused an `en` echo, so no leaf needed its parent's name added. Where Russian needs the parent to read correctly anyway, the leaf names it (for example `Описание виджета`, `Тип фильтра`, `Размеры виджета`).
- Vocabulary follows the existing `ru` plugin bundles: «» quotes, `Должность`, `Бизнес-подразделение`, `Набор разрешений`, `Дашборд`, `Очереди`, `Веб-хуки`, `HTTP-доставки`, `Общий доступ к записям`, `Настройки уведомлений`; hub titles exactly as service-settings spells them (`Доставка почты`, `Брендинг`, `Хранилище файлов`, `ИИ и Embedder`, …). Adjectives and participles agree with the noun they qualify (`Активен`/`Активны`, `Отключён`, `Отозван`, plural view names `Активные`, `Ожидающие`, …).
- Business units are `Бизнес-подразделения`; no `sys_business_unit*` label says `Отдел` (`bu-rename-consistency`). `Отдел` survives only as the unit-kind option value, which is not a label.
- Deviation: #31440 shipped a plugin-audit `pt-BR` twin of the #28107 activity-summary test. This PR does not add a `ru` twin, because plugin-audit is not in the claim's file surface; it can follow as its own card.

## Verification
- `os i18n extract packages/platform-objects/scripts/i18n-extract.config.ts --locales=zh-CN,ja-JP,es-ES,zh-Hant,ar,fr,pt-BR,ru --fill=default --source-hashes --out=packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations`: a rerun regenerates the `ru` bundles byte-identical and leaves the 23 other generated files unchanged (none of them is in the diff) (`cmp` over every file in the directory). `check-i18n-bundles --filter=platform-objects`: in sync (26 bundles).
- Resolved through `SetupAppTranslations`: `fr` `pages.connect_agent.subtitle` now starts `Travaillez dans ce système depuis Claude, Doubao…`; `ru` gets `Работайте с этой системой из Claude, Doubao…`.
- `vitest run` in platform-objects: 120 files, 1841 tests passed. plugin-approvals `approval-status-vocabulary` (6), plugin-security `people-org-assignment-nav-contribution` (5), service-settings `setup-nav-hub-parity` (19) and cli `platform-page-i18n-parity` (27) passed.
- platform-objects `typecheck`: exit 0. `check:app-nav-i18n`: OK (13 contributors, 9 locales, 2 apps).
- `dispatch-gates --ran` at 9c137f20 (after merging `origin/main`): 68 derived families, 68 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, all exit 0 (including `check:i18n`, `check:i18n-stale-fill`, `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:nul-bytes`).
- `eslint` over the changed `.ts` paths (scoped, `--no-inline-config`): exit 0.
